scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.kill-backend-port: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('Killing PID ' + $_.OwningProcess + ' on port 4000'); Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.kill-frontend-port: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('Killing PID ' + $_.OwningProcess + ' on port 3000'); Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run kill-dev && npm run dev
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && npm --prefix backend run db:init
